title: Join with Group By
code:
SELECT u.username, COUNT(o.id) as order_count
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
GROUP BY u.id, u.username;
explanation_md: Combines users and their orders, counting how many orders each user has made.

title: Common Table Expression (CTE)
description: Creating temporary result sets for complex queries.
explanation_md: CTEs improve readability by breaking down complex queries into logical blocks.

title: Window Function (Row Number)
explanation_md: Window functions perform calculations across a set of table rows that are related to the current row.

title: UPSERT Pattern
description: Inserting or updating a record if it already exists.
explanation_md: Standard PostgreSQL syntax for handling duplicate keys during an insert.

title: Subquery in WHERE Clause
description: Filtering based on the results of another query.
code:
SELECT name FROM products
WHERE category_id IN (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'Electronics');
explanation_md: Subqueries allow for dynamic filtering based on data in other tables.
